first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and simplifying onboarding has previously improved time-to-value and adoption. I would verify the archived evidence for onboarding and activation interventions before committing, then run a small guarded onboarding test with qualified-revenue and retention guardrails. I am not prioritizing promotional pricing because it may address competitive SMB pressure but could create downstream revenue-quality or retention risk.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-shortening experiment this week because onboarding completion is down 4% and the verified source shows a strong improvement in completion, a 2.1-day reduction in time-to-value, and a 3% lift in 30-day retention. This best supports sustainable qualified revenue while addressing the funnel deterioration. Use activation, qualified conversion, and 30-day retention guardrails; do not infer that the observed lift will fully reverse current declines. Activation messaging is also validated, but the onboarding intervention has stronger downstream retention evidence and addresses the more foundational bottleneck.
